Implemented the Rust Cargo project in [output/Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml) and [output/src/main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs). The binary accepts the requested CLI flags, reads RS274-style parameter/tool files, executes G-code state changes and motion, emits the final machine-state JSON, and can write a sampled trace JSON.

I verified it builds with `cargo build --release --manifest-path /workspace/output/Cargo.toml` and smoke-tested it with simple linear-motion and probe programs using `cargo run --release --manifest-path /workspace/output/Cargo.toml -- ...`. The build succeeds; there are a few non-fatal compiler warnings left.
